decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming and dental lab material know-how, so it can interpret lab feedback and keep improving the line at low cost, even though the website no longer shows it separately.
The PETG thermoforming blank sits within the firm's established thermoforming competence and in-house R&D, making it a low-risk, easily refined part of the core material range.

Custom hearing protection earmolds use the firm's earmold manufacturing and digital production know-how in an adjacent market it understands, but the withdrawal of the related earmold line and its lower website visibility add some risk.
